description: Supabase getSession() calls that are not trusted identity: a route gated on getUser() that uses getSession() only to forward the access token, refresh-only middleware, a login page that moves a signed-in visitor along, a 'signed in as' greeting, a 'use client' component (getSession is fine in the browser), and an OAuth callback reading the session a successful exchangeCodeForSession() just issued. VC221 must stay silent on all six.
